lines.en: Thais, you will not believe my morning. The technician asked whether I had backed up my files. I had not!
lines.pt: Thais, você não vai acreditar na minha manhã. O técnico perguntou se eu tinha feito backup dos arquivos. Eu não tinha!

lines.en: Oh no. What happened? Did the system crash again, or had the hard drive been corrupted?
lines.pt: Ai, não. O que aconteceu? O sistema travou de novo, ou o HD tinha sido corrompido?

lines.en: The drive was corrupted. He asked me when I had last saved the report, and I said on Friday.
lines.pt: O HD estava corrompido. Ele perguntou quando eu tinha salvo o relatório pela última vez, e respondi que foi na sexta.

lines.en: Then he must have asked if you had copied it to the cloud. I hope you had.
lines.pt: Então ele deve ter perguntado se você tinha copiado para a nuvem. Espero que sim.

lines.en: He did. I told him that I had saved it to a folder, but I could not remember which one.
lines.pt: Perguntou, sim. Eu disse que tinha salvado numa pasta, mas não lembrava qual.

lines.en: Typical! Did he ask whether you had accidentally saved over anything? Never overwrite a file; that causes the worst damage.
lines.pt: Típico! Ele perguntou se você tinha salvado por cima de algo sem querer? Nunca sobrescreva um arquivo; isso causa o pior estrago.

lines.en: Yes, and he wanted to know if I had installed any strange program recently. I told him I had not.
lines.pt: Sim, e quis saber se eu tinha instalado algum programa estranho recentemente. Disse que não.

lines.en: Did he explain how long it would take to recover everything? I need the sales figures by tomorrow.
lines.pt: Ele explicou quanto tempo levaria para recuperar tudo? Preciso dos números de vendas até amanhã.

lines.en: He said he would try to retrieve the data, but he asked me whether I had a copy on my phone.
lines.pt: Disse que tentaria resgatar os dados, mas me perguntou se eu tinha uma cópia no celular.

lines.en: Do you? I remember that you had sent the figures to our manager the day before yesterday.
lines.pt: Você tem? Lembro que você tinha enviado os números ao nosso gerente anteontem.

lines.en: Of course! I had completely forgotten. I will ask her whether she has kept the email. Thanks, Thais!
lines.pt: Claro! Eu tinha me esquecido completamente. Vou perguntar a ela se guardou o e-mail. Obrigada, Thais!

facts.label: Perguntas reportadas
facts.sub: Pergunta indireta no passado: He asked whether I had backed up. Ordem direta, sem do/did. Wh-: He asked when I had saved it.

facts.label: Se
facts.sub: Pergunta de sim ou não vira if ou whether: Did you back up? → He asked whether I had backed up. Os dois significam “se”. Whether é um pouco mais formal que if.

facts.label: Past perfect
facts.sub: Depois de asked, wanted to know, wondered, o tempo recua: Did you save it? → whether I had saved it. Have you installed? → if I had installed.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A reported question uses if or whether.
We say “He asked whether had I saved it”.
items.why: We use statement order: whether I had saved it.

items.s: Past simple often becomes past perfect.
items.why: Yes: Did you save it? → whether I had saved it.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A reported question uses if or whether. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He asked whether had I saved it”. → Falso (We use statement order: whether I had saved it.)
Past simple often becomes past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes: Did you save it? → whether I had saved it.)

pages.title: The lost report · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a stressful Wednesday in an office in Vancouver. Dot has just left a meeting about her lost backup. Her face is pale. Her colleague Tom is drinking coffee. He notices that something is wrong. Dot tells him about the questions.

“Tom, you will not believe my morning. The technician asked whether I had backed up my files. I had not!” says Dot. “Oh no. What happened? Did the system crash again, or had the hard drive been corrupted?” says Tom. “The drive was corrupted. He asked me when I had last saved the report, and I said on Friday.” says Dot.
